# thoughts

> Garden tag: thoughts

## Garden

- [Fomenting the Butlerian Jihad](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/fomenting-the-butlerian-jihad.md): Real risks of transformer-based AI worth planning for: job displacement, cognitive dependency, psychogenic feedback loops, and alignment failure.
- [A General-Purpose Industry-Refining Tool](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/general-purpose-industry-refining-tool.md): Refinement of industries - industrialization - has a rhyming shape every time it crops up.
- [How I Learned to Stop Coding and Love the Machine](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/how-i-learned-to-stop-coding-and-love-the-machine.md): AI tools that have become indispensable: Gemini Deep Research, Cursor for coding, CodeRabbit for reviews, and more.
- [The Last Programming Language](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/last-programming-language.md): The entire history of programming languages has been a project to close the gap between human intent and machine execution. LLMs are the endpoint.
- [What is a Digital Garden?](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/what-is-a-digital-garden.md): And why I planted one. Curated collections of content and hyperlinks, organized for wandering and discovery.
